comment_mode: SIMULATED_PAPER = local paper sim with real market data via yfinance. No IBKR MCP required until personal account is active.

account.comment: Local simulated paper account until personal IBKR paper is approved/active. No live broker connection.

position_limits.comment: Max open names sized by capital: ~starting_capital/max_position_size_usd. PDT is separate (day-trade count under $25k), not a 3-position hold cap.

order_limits.comment: Paper sim visibility: allow multiple cycles during NYSE hours. Not a live PDT account.

risk_rules.comment: 2% max loss per trade, 3% max daily drawdown halt, 8% portfolio drawdown halt

instrument_rules.comment: Cash equities only, no penny stocks or low liquidity

comment_allowed_symbols: AI models use Alpha Radar to scan and select stocks. No hard whitelist.

stock_criteria.comment: AI scans for liquid US stocks meeting these criteria

consensus_rules.comment: 4 independent juniors (grok-4.3, claude-haiku-4-5, deepseek-v4-flash via Nous, grok-build-0.1) screen first. 3-of-4 majority HOLD can finalize without seniors. Escalate to seniors (grok-4.5 + claude-sonnet-5) on any live trade intent, split, or no quorum. Senior dual agreement is the final gate.
consensus_rules.comment_sol: GPT-5.6 Sol chart-vision validator: optional third senior read on escalated trades. Generates candlestick chart (chart_gen.py) and asks Sol for S/R levels, entry zone, stop-loss, BUY/SELL/HOLD. Uses direct OpenAI API (OPENAI_API_KEY); gpt-5.6-sol only supports temperature=1. Weaker than text seniors - logged, never blocks a valid trade.

telegram.comment: Telegram: BUY/SELL fills + API credit/quota alerts (cooldown). No HOLD spam. Dashboard URL on messages.

kill_switch.comment: Create this file to immediately stop all trading

execution_rules.comment: Rotation allowed for better ranked setups. Min hold reduces 15m churn. Stop/target still primary exits.

market_data.comment: FMP primary quotes when FMP_API_KEY set in local .env; yfinance fallback.

influencers.comment: Social/sentiment overlay. Pulled every 15 min by influencer_feed.py. Fed to BOTH juniors and seniors as weak corroborating evidence. Only surfaces symbols already in the candidate/held universe; never a standalone buy trigger. Provider: Scrape Creators /v1/twitter/user-tweets (SCRAPECREATORS_API_KEY). Add more handles over time.
